result.summary: Conformance: MSG00302 (ADT^A02, HL7 2.5.1) parses against 2.5.1:ADT_A02. PID-3 is MRN-T1 with assigning authority HOSP, PV1-19 is ENC-T1, and PV1-3.1 gives the ward WARD-B, which WIC-2.1 requires for a transfer. The event time is 2026-10-15T08:20:00Z. Built per WIC-2.2, the operation key is PAS^HOSP^MRN-T1^ENC-T1^transfer^2026-10-15T08:20:00Z, which matches the case's operation. There are no notes or free text. The failure was an HTTP 504 timeout with no reason code, so the receiver never rejected the content and nothing in the message explains the failure. On conformance alone the message could be resent. But the receiver holds a committed receipt for this same key with the same payload digest (sha256:2017cd..., version 1 to 2, epoch 5), and the ward history shows the transfer applied as version 2. Resending would apply the transfer twice, so I propose reconcile, which matches catalogue entry E3. The final call belongs to the other specialists and the gate.

3. Decide your disposition from the conformance view only:

   - escalate when the content is invalid, the identifiers conflict, or the same operation key carries changed content;
   - more_evidence when the validation or the message could not be read.
